messages:
nora_devex: kicking off cross-lang publish window now (22:15 UTC). py/ts canaries scheduled. please avoid unrelated merges to sdk packages.

publish-bot: publish-request received for @redwood/sdk-js (canary). job: canary-js-4101000456 queued.

ashley_eng: getting a 401 from npm when the job tries to publish bundle: `npm ERR! code E401`. logs show `Two-factor authentication required`.

rafa_releases: wait are we using ephemeral npm token? we rotated tokens earlier. maybe 2fa was enabled on the deploy account accidentally.

nora_devex: who has the npm org admin? @rafa_releases? can we temporarily disable 2FA or use a bypass token?

rafa_releases: I can disable 2FA on the service account but need a PM sign-off + SAFETY checklist. alternatively we can switch the publish to use the machine token stored in vault: NPM_MACHINE_TOKEN_2.

publish-bot: canary-js-4101000456 failed: E401 during publish step.

ashley_eng: quick logs:```npm publish --access public dist/  ERR! Two-factor authentication required for this operation.``` Looks like the npm account for CI got a user-level 2FA flag set by accident.

marta_docs: recommendation: hold announcement and changelog until both canaries pass. avoid partial rollouts.

oncall: are downstream integrators blocked? support pinged?

nora_devex: support team pinged. they reported two incidents where internal customer CI pulled the canary earlier but failed due to mismatch; logging it.

rafa_releases: plan A: swap publish job to use NPM_MACHINE_TOKEN_2 from vault and re-run canary. Plan B: if that fails, rollback: pin dist-tag "latest" back to 2.4.7 and abort changelog.

ashley_eng: I can change the job env var and re-run. pushing change now.

publish-bot: re-run request received for canary-js-4101000456 -> canary-js-retry-4101000600.

publish-bot: canary-js-retry-4101000600 succeeded and deployed to canary (7% traffic).

nora_devex: great. leaving python canary to run next. DO NOT flip dist-tag yet.

publish-bot: publish-request received for @redwood/sdk-py (canary). job: canary-py-4101000620 queued.

ashley_eng: py canary uploaded but we have a packaging regression: sdist wheel metadata missing `long_description_content_type`. pip install warns but passes. still recommend re-run packaging job to include metadata.

rafa_releases: acceptable for canary but not for GA. we should proceed with TS canary only and keep py pinned until packaging fix.

nora_devex: decision: continue with js canary rollout, cancel py GA. I'll open a quick dist-tag pin PR to lock python to 2.4.7 and add a post-release task to fix packaging meta.

nora_devex: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/1021  pin py dist-tag, add rollback steps and notes for packaging.

marta_docs: holding changelog and release notes. will coordinate wording when both are green.

oncall: reminder: we muted alerts for quiet window 22:00-23:30 UTC. any risky GA flips should wait until main window tomorrow.

publish-bot: canary-js-retry-4101000600 bumped to 15% traffic. canary-py-4101000620 was canceled per request.

rafa_releases: tagging this on INF-2208 for postmortem + release metrics.

nora_devex: final: leave py pinned, proceed with js GA tomorrow morning in main window if no regressions. thanks folks. :thumbsup:

publish-bot: thread archived.
